proposed_claim: PROV-lite can provide VAKS with a lightweight entity/activity/agent skeleton for source provenance.

anchor_refs.exact: ## 初步看点 - PROV 的核心描述对象是 entities、activities 和 people/agents involved in producing data or things。 - PROV-DM 是 W3C provenance family 的 conceptual data model。 - 这正好可以给本项目的 source provenance 提供轻量词汇，但不要求 source record 承担 review、promotion 或 context-pack 使用日志。

allowed_expression.text: PROV-lite 可以给 VAKS 的 source provenance 提供轻量的 entity / activity / agent 骨架。

proposed_claim: PROV traceability is scope-limited: it records traceability, but it does not decide truth, raise confidence, or turn a citation into support.

anchor_refs.exact: ## 边界 ```text PROV-lite records traceability. It does not decide truth. It does not raise confidence. It does not turn a citation into support. ```

allowed_expression.text: PROV traceability 只能作为可追踪性和复核辅助；当前资料不支持把它升级成 reviewed truth confidence 或 action-ready evidence support。
